Shared typography, border, radius, and spacing tokens are not being applied consistently.

Align heading weight and size, body text, section-label color, spacing, and control sizing with shared design tokens.
Standardize card borders, radii, dividers, switch styling, radio indicators, and status-badge treatments across platforms.

The iOS response mapper does not populate the expected name, handle, avatar, role, email, joined date, and agent-count fields.
iOS is rendering a generic header and fallback error component because the member record was unavailable.

Align the iOS header bounds and spacing with React, including the avatar, member-specific title and subtitle, trailing action icon, and divider position.
Add automated coverage for successful, loading, and failed member-profile states so transient API failures are not captured as the successful baseline.
Normalize both snapshots to the same logical viewport and crop contract before pixel comparison.
